### Story Intent

- **Beneficiary:** governed story owner resuming verification after an authorized rebase
- **Capability:** retire an exact stale Test receipt before its old ancestry deadlocks fresh entry
- **Need:** the old receipt is audited before canonical retirement can run after the source commit changes
- **Value or failure prevented:** fresh exact-head verification proceeds without manual proof edits or weakened provenance checks

### Semantic review of stakeholder value

All seven questions pass: beneficiary is the operator owning a rebased story; capability is exact stale-result retirement with fresh verification; need is the observed entry deadlock; counterfactual is prohibited manual proof editing or blocked delivery; scope and actual refusal ground every claim; scope differs from prior retirement and readiness fixes; the standalone story names the rebase, invalid old ancestry and safe fresh verification. No semantic review is inferred from deterministic validation.
